title: The Wigner transform is an L2 isometry up to the semiclassical factor
author: Marnie Smith
work: Uniform semiclassical nonlinear Hartree phase mixing and weighted scattering for small perturbations
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `L2normofWigner` at source lines 474-479: for Q in L2(R^d;C) the Wigner transform satisfies ||W[Q]||_{L2, x,xi} = (2 pi hbar)^{-d/2} ||Q||_{L2, x,y} = ||Q||_{L^2}. The proof (source lines 480-485) is short but it is a computation with two named ingredients that both have to be invoked in the right variable: the Wigner transform is first identified with a scaled Fourier transform in the relative variable xi of the product Q(x + ./2, x - ./2) (source line 483), and Plancherel is then applied in that same variable (source line 484). Getting the constant (2 pi hbar)^{-d/2} out requires matching the prefactor of the transform against the change of variables in the two-variable norm, which is exactly what the statement asserts and the proof does not spell out beyond the display.
